username.description: Windows domain account username for NTLM authentication (without domain prefix)

domain.description: Windows domain name — use the NetBIOS short name (e.g. CORP) or FQDN

workstation.description: Workstation name sent in NTLM negotiation; leave blank to use the system hostname

pass_ntlmv2.description: NTLMv2 password hash — generate with: cntlm -H -u user@DOMAIN -d DOMAIN (never store plaintext passwords)

pass_lm.description: LM password hash — only required when Auth includes LM; generate with cntlm -H

pass_nt.description: NT password hash — only required when Auth includes NT; generate with cntlm -H

auth.description: NTLM authentication method: NTLMv2 (recommended), NTLM, NTLM2SR, LM, NT, or a space-separated combination

flags.description: NTLM protocol flags bitmask — leave at default unless the upstream proxy requires specific flags

proxies.description: One or more upstream corporate NTLM proxy endpoints; tried in order for failover

no_proxy.description: Hosts, IPs, and wildcard patterns to connect to directly, bypassing the proxy

listen_port.description: Local TCP port cntlm listens on; point applications at 127.0.0.1:<listen_port>

gateway.description: If true, bind all interfaces so remote clients can use cntlm; if false, localhost only

isa_scanner_size.description: Skip ISA virus scanner pre-authorization for responses larger than this many kB; 0 disables

allow_rules.description: IP addresses or CIDR ranges allowed to connect to cntlm; evaluated before Deny rules

deny_rules.description: IP addresses or CIDR ranges denied access; add 0/0 last to block all unmatched clients

socks5_enabled.description: Enable a SOCKS5 proxy listener in addition to the HTTP proxy

socks5_port.description: TCP port for the SOCKS5 listener (only active when socks5_enabled is true)

socks5_user.description: Optional SOCKS5 client username; leave empty to allow unauthenticated SOCKS5 access

tunnels.description: TCP port-forwarding tunnels routed through the corporate proxy (useful for non-HTTP protocols)

local_port.description: Local TCP port cntlm listens on for this tunnel

remote_host.description: Target hostname or IP the tunnel forwards to

remote_port.description: Target TCP port the tunnel forwards to
